title: AbstractCellComplex — dimension function on a face poset
body_html:
AbstractCellComplex

The paper's §2.1 assumes $X$ is a locally finite regular CW complex with a cellular $G$-action — see Locally finite regular CW complex with cellular G-action for the topological statement. The Lean formalisation extracts the purely combinatorial content that all of §§2–4 actually uses:

the face poset $[\![X]\!]$ plus a dimension function $\dim$ with matching monotonicity axioms.

Signature

lean class AbstractCellComplex (X : Type*) [PartialOrder X] where dim : X → ℕ dim_lt : ∀ {E F : X}, E ≤ F → E ≠ F → dim E < dim F exists_face_dim_pred : ∀ {F : X}, 0 < dim F → ∃ E : X, E < F ∧ dim E + 1 = dim F

Adds to [PartialOrder X]:

  • a dimension function dim : X → ℕ;
  • strict monotonicity (dim_lt): a proper face has strictly smaller dimension;
  • face existence (exists_face_dim_pred): every cell of positive dimension has a face of dimension one less. Without this axiom one could have a "2-cell" attached directly to a vertex with no edges in between, which is not the face poset of any regular CW complex.

Design choice: data, not Prop

AbstractCellComplex is a class (data), not a Prop — the dimension function dim is genuine data that has to be supplied. Statements that are pure properties of dim (like "each cell has finitely many faces") live in the separate IsLocallyFinite — finite faces and finite cofaces Prop mixin.

Downstream

  • IsLocallyFinite — finite faces and finite cofaces — the finiteness Prop mixin.
  • GCellComplex — cellular G-action compatibility — the cellular $G$-action Prop class.
  • Subcomplex — face-closed subset of cells — face-closed subsets.
  • Alexandrov star topology on the face poset — the Alexandrov star topology on the face poset.
